set_lora: set LoRA adapter(s) for specified transformer(s) with nickname, path, target, and strength parameters
merge_lora_weights: merge LoRA weights into the base model for specified transformer(s) with optional strength
unmerge_lora_weights: unmerge LoRA weights from the base model for specified transformer(s)
list_loras: list loaded LoRA adapters and current application status per module
retrieve_model: retrieve a model instance with extended diffusion-specific metadata fields
